I replied to Marcus in his #north-random thread. I told him I've noted the correction: the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 15 August, as their ops lead said. I also pointed out that 15 August has already passed this year (today is 14 October 2026) and asked him to say if they meant a different date.

Since he said no action was needed, I didn't do anything else.
